comment: Pinned inputs of the GRUB build (build/grub/grubsrc.py). Every file is checked against its SHA-256 before use. Change only together with build/grub/security-fixes.json (see docs/SECURE_BOOT.md, 'Where grubx64.efi comes from').
purl_distro_comment: distro qualifier of our GRUB's purl (scripts/gen_sbom.py, via build-info.json): the series this source package comes from, so scanners compare it with that series' grub2-unsigned data - never the build host's series

source.name: grub2_2.14.orig.tar.xz
source.note: byte-identical to the upstream release tarball https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/grub/grub-2.14.tar.xz

minilzo.comment: debian/rules copies /usr/share/lzo/minilzo/*.[ch] (liblzo2-dev, newer than GRUB's bundled copy) into grub-core/lib/minilzo/; we take them from this pinned .deb

unifont.comment: Build-Depends xfonts-unifont: configure finds unifont.pcf.gz and generates the built-in ASCII font (font.mod) and the character width table (normal.mod) from it

host_tools.comment: Code generators GRUB's autogen.sh / build need. Used only when the host lacks them: unpacked without root into the cache (no maintainer scripts). Ubuntu 26.04 versions.

docker.comment: Builder used when the host cannot build natively (BB_GRUB_BUILDER=docker forces it). apt resolves the packages against the Ubuntu snapshot archive at 'snapshot', so the toolchain is pinned too.
